---
name: "nf-core/utils_nfvalidation_plugin"
description: "Use nf-validation to initiate and validate a pipeline"
keywords:
- "utility"
- "pipeline"
- "initialise"
- "validation"
components: []
input:
- print_help:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Print help message and exit\n"
- workflow_command:
    type: "string"
    description: "The command to run the workflow e.g. \"nextflow run main.nf\"\n"
- pre_help_text:
    type: "string"
    description: "Text to print before the help message\n"
- post_help_text:
    type: "string"
    description: "Text to print after the help message\n"
- validate_params:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Validate the parameters and error if invalid.\n"
- schema_filename:
    type: "string"
    description: "The filename of the schema to validate against.\n"
output:
- dummy_emit:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Dummy emit to make nf-core subworkflows lint happy\n"
authors:
- "@adamrtalbot"
maintainers:
- "@adamrtalbot"
- "@maxulysse"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
